description: Source code for WebSocket server implementation handling handshake, message reading, and sending frames within the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Implements WebSocket protocol handling including handshake, message processing, and frame encoding/decoding.

methods.name: WebSocket::Accept
methods.description: Handles WebSocket handshake request, validates headers, generates response, and initializes encoder.

methods.name: WebSocket::Read
methods.description: Reads and decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handles control frames like ping/pong.

methods.name: WebSocket::Send
methods.description: Encodes and sends WebSocket frames of specified opcode.

methods.name: WebSocket::Fail
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and logs the failure.

methods.name: WebSocket::SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP 500 error response and closes the connection.
